definitions.explanation: Hair that has become messy or stuck out at odd angles from sleeping on it.

examples.japanese: {寝癖|ねぐせ}を{直|なお}してから{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I fixed my bed hair before going out.

examples.japanese: {寝癖|ねぐせ}がついたまま{会社|かいしゃ}に{来|き}てしまって{恥|は}ずかしかった。
examples.english: I was embarrassed that I came to the office with bed hair still sticking up.

notes:
{寝癖|ねぐせ} refers to hair that has become messy or sticks out at odd angles from sleeping. Composed of {寝|ね} (sleep) + {癖|くせ} (habit/tendency). Also written as {寝|ね}ぐせ in mixed script.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝癖|ねぐせ}がつく: to get bed hair
- {寝癖|ねぐせ}を{直|なお}す: to fix bed hair
- {寝癖|ねぐせ}がひどい: to have bad bed hair
- {寝癖|ねぐせ}がついたまま: with bed hair still sticking up

FIXING BED HAIR:
Japanese people typically fix {寝癖|ねぐせ} by wetting the hair with {水|みず} (water) or using a {櫛|くし} (comb). Some use {寝癖|ねぐせ}{直|なお}しスプレー (bed-hair-fixing spray).

NOTE:
A relatable everyday topic in Japanese conversation — talking about one's {寝癖|ねぐせ} is common and lighthearted.
